title: Especialista de Planograma
description:
Empresa está contratando Especialista de Planograma em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

PLANOGRAMA    Objetivo da Posição    O Especialista em Planogramas é responsável por criar, entregar e aprimorar continuamente planogramas de alta qualidade dentro do  CatExpert.ai   , a plataforma de Gestão por Categorias impulsionada por IA da AB InBev, atualmente utilizada em mais de 15 mercados ao redor do mundo.   Trata-se de uma posição operacional e prática, com forte orientação para o negócio. O profissional atuará em estreita colaboração com equipes de mercado em diferentes zonas geográficas para garantir que os planogramas sejam visualmente precisos, estrategicamente alinhados e aderentes aos parâmetros de negócio definidos.   A posição está no centro da capacidade de execução de gôndola do CatExpert.ai, transformando lógicas de clusterização de lojas, definições de espaço e diretrizes de fluxo em planogramas capazes de gerar melhorias mensuráveis nos KPIs de varejo.   A pessoa nessa função será a principal referência operacional para entrega de planogramas em seus mercados, impulsionando qualidade, velocidade e consistência em escala, fator essencial para suportar o crescimento do CatExpert.ai rumo à geração simultânea de milhares de planogramas em mercados globais.   2. Principais Responsabilidades    Desenvolvimento e Entrega de Planogramas   Criar e entregar versões de planogramas com base na clusterização de lojas, definições de espaço e diretrizes de fluxo aprovadas por cada mercado.   Garantir que os planogramas sejam visualmente atrativos, comercialmente corretos e aderentes aos parâmetros de negócio e padrões de exposição definidos.   Apoiar o objetivo de geração de planogramas em escala dentro do CatExpert.ai, permitindo processamento paralelo de grande volume para múltiplos mercados simultaneamente.   Manter controle de versões e documentação de todos os planogramas produzidos, assegurando rastreabilidade e auditoria das solicitações dos mercados.    Colaboração com Mercados e Gestão de Stakeholders    Atuar como principal parceiro operacional dos mercados em diferentes regiões, promovendo alinhamento e consistência na execução dos planogramas.   Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de Gestão por Categorias dos mercados para validar parâmetros dos planogramas e garantir impacto positivo nos resultados de negócio.   Coletar e incorporar rapidamente feedbacks dos mercados, ajustando os planogramas conforme mudanças nas estratégias de exposição.    Excelência Operacional e Controle de Qualidade    Conduzir melhorias contínuas nos processos para aumentar eficiência, qualidade e velocidade de entrega dos planogramas.   Identificar gargalos na construção dos planogramas e propor soluções, especialmente aquelas que possam ser resolvidas por meio das funcionalidades do CatExpert.ai.   Comparar a qualidade dos planogramas gerados com ferramentas concorrentes, como JDA, SpacePlano e ShelfIQ, sinalizando oportunidades de melhoria ao time de produto.    Gestão de Projetos    Gerenciar simultaneamente múltiplos projetos de planogramas, demonstrando forte capacidade de priorização e cumprimento de prazos.   Manter visibilidade clara sobre pipeline, cronogramas e status das entregas, comunicando proativamente avanços e impedimentos aos stakeholders.   3. Qualificações, Experiência e Competências    Formação Acadêmica   Ensino superior completo.   Formação em Administração, Gestão do Varejo ou áreas correlatas será considerada diferencial.    Experiência Obrigatória    Entre 5 e 8 anos de experiência em planejamento de espaço e execução de planogramas utilizando ferramentas como  JDA, Spaceman, Hoffrogge   ou similares.   Experiência prática com planejamento de layout de lojas e otimização de espaços de vendas.   Histórico comprovado de entrega de planogramas para múltiplos mercados ou contas varejistas simultaneamente.   Experiência de trabalho com equipes de Gestão por Categorias ou Trade Marketing em empresas de bens de consumo (CPG/FMCG).    Desejável    Experiência com ferramentas de planogramas baseadas em inteligência artificial ou plataformas de automação.   Conhecimento de metodologias de clusterização de lojas e sua aplicação na definição de espaço de gôndola.   Experiência em ambientes globais ou multinacionais, atuando com stakeholders de diferentes culturas.    Idiomas    Inglês:   nível intermediário.   Português ou Espanhol:   nível avançado/proficiente.    4. Competências Técnicas    Obrigatórias   Proficiência em softwares de planejamento de espaço como  JDA, Spaceman, Hoffrogge   ou equivalentes.   Excel avançado, incluindo manipulação de dados, tabelas dinâmicas e relatórios.   Sólido conhecimento de parâmetros de conformidade de planogramas, métricas de gôndola (facings, capacidade, fluxo) e KPIs de varejo.   Capacidade de interpretar layouts físicos de loja e resultados de clusterização.    Desejáveis    Experiência com o  CatExpert.ai   ou plataformas semelhantes de gestão por categorias baseadas em IA.   Conhecimentos básicos de SQL ou consultas de dados para extração de informações de vendas e espaço.   Familiaridade com ferramentas de validação de planogramas por imagem.      INFORMAÇÕES BENEFICIOS:   40 dias de home office;   Vale refeição ou alimentação ifood;   Vale transporte;   Bônus;   Plano de saúde e Telemedicina;   Convênio odontológico;   Convênio Farmácia;   Seguro de vida;   Instituto Ambev de Previdência Privada;   Auxílio Material Escolar;   Cesta de Natal e Kit Congelado;   Brinquedos de Natal;   Empresa cidadã (licença maternidade e paternidade) e presente do bebê;   Desconto mensal em produtos AMBEV;   Wellhub (Gympass);   Fretado;   Abono anual referente a um salário.

title: Regional Sales Representative
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Regional Sales Representative em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Position Details   Job Title:   Regional Sales Representative — Campinas, São Paulo   Department:   Sales — IoT/M2M Connectivity   Location:   Campinas, São Paulo, Brazil — field-based and remote work, with frequent regional travel   Employment Type:   Full-Time (CLT or PJ, to be defined based on candidate profile)  Reports To:   Head of Sales LATAM    Role Context    We are expanding our commercial team in Brazil with dedicated territorial coverage by region. São Paulo, anchored in Campinas, is part of this expansion, given the volume of strategic accounts already established in the area and the active presence of competitors (Virtueyes, Datatem, Allcom, among others).    What You'll Do    Prospect, develop, and close deals with medium and large companies in São Paulo, focused on fleet management, asset tracking, and related IoT verticals.   Act as the local commercial point of contact, with recurring in-person presence at clients and prospects across São Paulo.   Build and manage your own pipeline, from qualification through close, in coordination with the Head of Sales LATAM and the Inside Sales/SDR team.   Track and monitor local competitors (MVNOs and IoT connectivity providers operating in the region).   Present technical-commercial proposals, including products such as SIM DUO, vSIM, and eSIM, together with the Solutions team.   Negotiate contracts, commercial terms, and SLAs with corporate clients.   Report pipeline metrics, forecast, and results in a structured way.     What We Expect    Farm and Grow the Existing Base    Take ownership of and grow the accounts already established in São Paulo, increasing volume and revenue within the current portfolio.   Keep clients satisfied through constant visits and recurring in-person presence — not just remote contact.   Ensure fast response to client requests and demands, acting as their trusted local point of contact.   Anticipate churn risk and act proactively to retain and expand strategic accounts.    Grow — Bring In New Accounts    Prospect and close new accounts quickly, with a strong sense of urgency and focus on results.   Directly contribute to revenue growth in the region, not just maintenance of the current portfolio.   Establish Acceleronix's active presence in São Paulo — participation in events, trade shows, and visits that reinforce the brand locally.   Build a consistent pipeline of new business, without relying solely on leads handed over by the SDR team.     Requirements    Required    Based in Campinas, São Paulo, or willing to relocate to the region.   Proven track record in consultative B2B sales, preferably in telecom, connectivity, IoT/M2M, or technology.   Hybrid farmer/hunter profile — able to grow existing accounts while also generating and converting new pipeline.   Availability for frequent travel within the region.   Strong written and verbal communication, autonomy, and organization to manage a complex sales cycle.    Nice to Have    Prior experience at an MVNO, carrier, or IoT/M2M connectivity provider.   Familiarity with industry concepts: SIM DUO, vSIM, eSIM, national roaming, ICCID/IMSI/IMEI, LTE-M, NB-IoT.   Existing relationships with clients or partners in fleet management and vehicle tracking in São Paulo.   Intermediate/advanced English, for interaction with the Quectel group.     About Acceleronix    Acceleronix is Quectel's integrated IoT platform and connectivity company, built to help businesses launch and scale connected products faster. The company provides consulting, PCBA design, global SIM connectivity, and a secure device management platform, bringing hardware, connectivity, and software together into a single, end-to-end offering rather than requiring customers to stitch together separate vendors.    Operating as part of the Quectel ecosystem, Acceleronix is positioned as a trusted end-to-end IoT partner delivering scalable, reliable solutions from design through deployment, and appears alongside Quectel at major industry events such as MWC and the World IT Show to showcase joint IoT deployments across smart agriculture, smart home, and connected-device use cases.    Compensation & Benefits    Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market   Sales commission / performance bonus tied to new business and account growth   Meal and grocery vouchers   Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents   Dental coverage   Life insurance and accident cover   Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law   Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization     Learn More    Explore products, careers, and news at  , or follow  Quectel Wireless Solutions  on LinkedIn.   Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.     Acceleronix is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Customer Care Analyst
description:

This role requires excellent communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining composure and professionalism. A strong understanding of business needs is essential, along with the ability to contribute to a team dedicated to solving customer challenges.    Working Tasks and Responsibilities    Supporting all post-sales activities.   Successfully preparing, booking, and managing the lifecycle of all quotations in a timely manner, including their relevant follow-ups.   Handling incoming calls/inquiries from prospects, customers and leads.   Providing customers with technical support and general product and service information. Ensuring strict adherence to business processes and controls to ensure best-in-class customer service and seamless order management fulfillment.   Collaborating with other departments such as technical support, sales managers, product managers, etc.   Handling purchasing orders and import process monitoring.   Ensuring good document control and setting up new customers in CRM and updating existing records as needed.   Identifying, investigating, and resolving customer needs using the database/ERP system and other global webservice systems. What You’ll Bring    Education in Electronics/Industrial/Automation or Engineering or related field. Business education is also acceptable.   Experience in customer service, sales environment and/or technical procedures.   Passionate about customer service and customer-centric approach.   Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking.   Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills.   Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player.   Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.     At DEIF, we are Winning Together!   We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration are essential.    We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized as the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category. Seus Principais Desafios:    Gerenciar a área para obter melhores condições de compra para os produtos vendidos pela empresa, em termos de preços, qualidade e atendimento;   Entregar a meta esperada de  Cash   (prazos de pagamento) e as Metas de  Savings   (redução de custos);   Responsável pelo reporte (KPIs de projetos,  forecast   ,  savings   ...) relativo à região;   Dar suporte ao desenvolvimento de fornecedores de materiais e serviços para as fábricas que gerencia, bem como em quaisquer negociações necessárias;   Controlar e elaborar relatórios sobre os indicadores da área de compras e o desempenho da própria equipe ( savings   , prazos de pagamento, tempo de resposta, entre outros);   Atuar como intermediário entre requisitantes, compradores e fornecedores, sempre que necessário;   Planejar, apoiar, facilitar e gerenciar a equipe (individual e coletivamente);   Avaliar o desempenho da equipe, solicitando/realizando treinamentos de acordo com as necessidades identificadas, além de reunir-se com todos frequentemente, visando construir uma equipe coesa;   Apresentar frequentemente as atividades e resultados da área aos diretores/gerentes fabris para acompanhamento e melhoria contínua;   Responsável pela Gestão do Relacionamento com Fornecedores ( Supplier Relationship Management  ) na categoria, verificando o desempenho de todos os fornecedores do painel e garantindo a melhoria com um plano de ação robusto;   Contribuir fornecendo informações de análise de mercado e dados para a Alta Gestão dentro do prazo (ex.: resultados de RFQ, controle orçamentário, implementação de  workshops   , etc.);   Coletar necessidades das diferentes unidades por meio da rede de compradores locais/equipes de operações de todas as entidades, desafiando-as e introduzindo alternativas no Portfólio de  Sourcing   atual;   Participar ativamente de auditorias de clientes e da ISO 9000. Esta ação deve ser preparada com antecedência, com controle de documentação e evidências de conformidade com nossos processos;   Realizar outras atividades correlatas a critério do seu superior imediato e/ou em relação aos procedimentos do seu processo de trabalho, e/ou em relação ao procedimento do sistema integrado de gestão;   Manter-se comprometido com as políticas da empresa, seguindo constantemente as normas e procedimentos pré-estabelecidos, visando garantir a satisfação do cliente.     Principais tarefas e Responsabilidades:     Realizar o  sourcing   de produtos e serviços com tarifas competitivas e fornecimento confiável;   Dar suporte ao processo de Orçamento ( Budget  ) e premissas de tendências de mercado;   Liderar RFQs e negociar contratos e suprimentos com proatividade e conhecimento;   Implementar materiais alternativos e buscar inovação;   Acompanhar a legislação;   Identificar, gerenciar e executar projetos de  sourcing   em áreas correlatas dentro das unidades e da equipe industrial para reduzir custos, otimizar estruturas de tarifas e garantir serviços ininterrompidos às operações;   Implementar as melhores práticas; colaborar com colegas para compartilhar conhecimento e aprendizados para impulsionar a melhoria contínua;   Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com operações/fábricas, prestadores de serviço e consultores para otimizar os gastos por meio de projetos técnicos.     Requisitos de Formação e Experiência:     Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia ou Administração;   Mais de 10 anos de experiência em Compras;   Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência no mercado de MRO, Capex e Opex;   Consciência multicultural;   Trabalho em equipe;   Inglês Avançado/Fluente. Espanhol é um diferencial;   Capacidade de influenciar e obter adesão ( buy-in  ) em estruturas matriciais ("linha tracejada");   Compreensão das necessidades do negócio;   Disponibilidade para viagens.     Em compromisso com a Diversidade e Inclusão, esta oportunidade também é direcionada para candidatos PCD (Pessoa com Deficiência).

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.    Core Responsibilities:    Student Support & Intervention    Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.   Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.   Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.   Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.   Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.   Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.   Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.   Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.   Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.   Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.   Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.   Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.   Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.   Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.   Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.   Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.   Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.   Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.   Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.   Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.   Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).   Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.     Collaboration    Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.   Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.   Monitor students’ progress and well-being.   Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.   Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.   Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.   Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.   Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.   Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.   Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.     Operational and Professional Conduct    Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.   Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.   Maintain accurate student records.   Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.   Participate in professional development opportunities.   Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.   Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.   Follow the  EAC Safeguarding Guide  .     Other duties, as assigned.    Working Conditions:    Walk on paths and rough terrain   May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up     POSITION REQUIREMENTS    Minimum Education Required:     BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent   Minimum Experience Required:    Five years of teaching experience, preferred   Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.   Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.    Specific Knowledge:    Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.   Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.   Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.    Other Skills (Desirable):    Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.   Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.   Collegial and collaborative.   Innovative and creative.   Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.    English level required:    C1 or above   Portuguese level required:    none for teachers instructing in English   C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese    Child Safeguarding    Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.    EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion    EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: 经理
description:
Confira a oportunidade para 经理 em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

1. Assume overall responsibility for the industrial complex’s HSE team and management system. Develop annual HSE objectives, work plans, workforce plans, departmental budgets, and key improvement projects, and be accountable for overall HSE performance. 2. Establish and continuously improve HSE policies, standards, procedures, inspection mechanisms, and accountability systems in accordance with applicable Brazilian laws, regulations, and corporate requirements.  3. Establish an occupational risk management system and organize the implementation of Occupational Risk Management and the Risk Management Program (GRO/PGR), including risk identification and assessment, preparation of the occupational risk inventory and action plans, and ongoing monitoring of the effectiveness of risk control measures.  4. Organize routine safety inspections, special inspections, and management safety tours covering manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, utilities, equipment maintenance, laboratories, and office areas.  5. Establish a permit-to-work system for high-risk activities, with particular focus on hot work, work at height, confined-space entry, temporary electrical installations, electrical work, lifting operations, excavation, equipment maintenance, energy isolation, and work on pressurized systems.  6. Establish and supervise a Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) energy isolation program to prevent unexpected startup, electrical energization, pressurization, or energy release during equipment maintenance, commissioning, and cleaning.  7. Manage safety risks associated with machinery and equipment, electrical systems, regulated equipment, pressure vessels, lifting equipment, forklifts, storage racks, industrial gases, and utility facilities.  8. Ensure compliance with the Brazilian Regulatory Standards (Normas Regulamentadoras – NRs) applicable to the site’s risk profile, including requirements relating to machinery, electricity, material handling, ergonomics, flammable materials, fire protection, confined spaces, and work at height.  9. Lead the establishment and effective operation of the Specialized Services in Safety Engineering and Occupational Medicine (SESMT), coordinating occupational safety engineers, safety technicians, occupational physicians, occupational health nurses, and other professionals in the lawful performance of their duties.  10. Support the lawful establishment and effective operation of the Internal Commission for Accident and Harassment Prevention (CIPA), encouraging employee participation in hazard identification, accident prevention, safety improvement, and workplace harassment prevention.  11. Work with the occupational health and Human Resources teams to establish and implement the Occupational Health Medical Control Program (PCMSO), including occupational medical examinations, occupational exposure monitoring, occupational disease prevention, return-to-work management, and employee health promotion.  12. Ensure that occupational health and safety documentation and eSocial SST information are submitted in a timely, accurate, and complete manner, including information relating to workplace accidents, employee health surveillance, and occupational hazard exposure.  13. Organize the identification, assessment, monitoring, and control of occupational hazards, including noise, heat, dust, chemicals, vibration, radiation, lighting, and ergonomic risks.  14. Incorporate ergonomics and work-related psychosocial risks into occupational risk assessments and improvement plans, and continuously improve work organization, workstation design, and employee health management.  15. Establish a contractor HSE qualification and lifecycle management system covering contractor qualification reviews, site induction, risk communication, work permits, on-site supervision, performance evaluation, and disciplinary action for violations.  16. Implement lifecycle HSE management for site construction, expansion and modification projects, equipment installation, and commissioning. Participate in design reviews, construction method statement reviews, pre-startup readiness confirmation, and final safety acceptance.  17. Integrate HSE requirements into reviews of new projects, equipment, processes, materials, and engineering changes to ensure that safety and environmental risks are identified and controlled before implementation or commissioning.  18. Manage the procurement approval, storage, use, transportation, labeling, Safety Data Sheets, and emergency response requirements for chemicals, flammable and explosive materials, dangerous goods, and industrial gases.  19. Establish appropriate controls for electric shock, thermal runaway, fire, and chemical leakage risks associated with power batteries, high-voltage systems, electric drive systems, charging facilities, and battery energy storage systems.  20. Establish a fire safety management system covering the installation and maintenance of fire protection systems, fire access routes and evacuation passages, fire risk inspections, emergency evacuation, fire brigade management, and fire safety permits and licenses.  21. Establish a comprehensive emergency management system for the industrial complex and develop emergency response plans for fires, explosions, chemical spills, electric shock, confined-space incidents, falls from height, environmental pollution, extreme weather, and other foreseeable emergencies.  22. Organize emergency response teams, emergency resources and equipment, incident command mechanisms, and regular emergency drills. Evaluate drill performance and implement continuous improvements.  23. Establish reporting mechanisms for incidents, near misses, and high-potential events. Organize scene preservation, evidence collection, investigations, root cause analysis, corrective action verification, and site-wide sharing and implementation of lessons learned.  24. Organize rapid response to major injuries or fatalities, fires and explosions, environmental pollution, and other high-risk events. Promptly report such events to company management and support statutory external reporting and regulatory investigations.  25. Lead the establishment, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System and ISO 14001 Environmental Management System.  26. Organize HSE internal audits, compliance evaluations, management reviews, customer audits, and third-party certification audits, and ensure that all nonconformities are corrected and verified within the required timeframe.  27. Establish and maintain a register of applicable HSE laws, regulations, permits, and licenses. Regularly identify regulatory changes, assess compliance gaps, and drive corrective actions.  28. Lead or coordinate applications, amendments, renewals, and condition management for environmental licenses and related approvals, ensuring that all licenses and their associated conditions remain valid and are fully implemented.  29. Maintain the necessary professional communication with IBAMA, relevant state environmental agencies, local government authorities, labor inspection bodies, fire departments, and other regulatory agencies, and coordinate regulatory inspections and document submissions.  30. Establish environmental management and monitoring mechanisms covering wastewater, air emissions, noise, solid waste, hazardous waste, soil, groundwater, and water abstraction and use.  31. Manage the classification, labeling, storage, transfer, transportation, and compliant disposal of hazardous and general industrial waste, ensuring that Waste Transport Manifests (MTRs) and final disposal certificates are complete and fully traceable.  32. Manage environmental monitoring programs and regularly analyze data relating to air emissions, wastewater discharge, noise, water consumption, energy consumption, waste generation, recycling, and resource recovery.  33. Establish environmental pollution prevention and spill-control mechanisms, with particular focus on chemical storage areas, oils and fuels, wastewater treatment facilities, hazardous waste temporary storage areas, and stormwater and wastewater drainage systems.  34. Manage the investigation, corrective action, reporting, and closure of environmental complaints, spills, abnormal discharges, and other environmental incidents.  35. Establish an HSE training system and organize induction training, specialized training, and competency certification for new employees, transferred employees, contractors, and personnel engaged in high-risk activities.  36. Promote a strong site-wide safety culture by establishing hazard reporting, near-miss reporting, stop-work authority, management safety observations, and employee participation and improvement mechanisms.  37. Establish an HSE KPI management system, organize regular HSE meetings, and issue daily, weekly, monthly, and special risk reports.  38. Manage HSE expenditures relating to personal protective equipment, fire protection systems, occupational health surveillance, environmental monitoring, waste disposal, and external professional services, while continuously identifying improvement and cost-optimization opportunities.  39. Manage HSE organizational planning, recruitment and staffing, job responsibilities, competency matrices, professional training, performance coaching, succession planning, and talent development.  40. Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Equipment, Logistics, Quality, Human Resources, Procurement, Legal, Government Affairs, Facilities Management, and other departments to ensure the timely resolution of HSE issues.

title: Gerente de Projetos (SAP Global)
description:
Empresa está contratando Gerente de Projetos (SAP Global) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Sobre a vaga    Estamos conduzindo uma das principais iniciativas de transformação de processos e tecnologia da companhia: o desenho e implementação de uma solução global baseada em  SAP S/4HANA   , que será implementada progressivamente nos diferentes países onde a Ambev possui operações.   Como  Project Manager   , você terá um papel estratégico na estruturação e gestão dos projetos que compõem o programa  Aurora   , garantindo a integração entre diferentes frentes de trabalho, o alinhamento entre stakeholders e o acompanhamento da evolução das entregas.    Principais responsabilidades     Estruturar e gerenciar  planos de trabalho integrados   entre as diferentes frentes do programa, garantindo alinhamento de escopo, cronograma, dependências e entregáveis;   Construir e acompanhar o  planejamento integrado dos projetos   , conectando atividades, marcos e prioridades entre diferentes times e stakeholders;   Realizar o  tracking das principais ações, entregas, dependências, riscos e issues   , garantindo visibilidade sobre o andamento dos projetos e acionamento das áreas responsáveis;   Estruturar e conduzir  fóruns, workshops e reuniões de alinhamento   , promovendo colaboração e tomada de decisão entre as diferentes frentes;   Elaborar  apresentações de status, reports gerenciais e materiais executivos   , traduzindo informações complexas em análises claras e objetivas para diferentes públicos;   Apoiar a  governança dos projetos   , garantindo cadência de acompanhamento, definição de prioridades e escalonamento de temas críticos;   Realizar o planejamento e acompanhamento de  cronograma, escopo, recursos, custos e orçamento (budget)  dos projetos;   Trabalhar em conjunto com diferentes áreas e stakeholders, garantindo alinhamento das entregas e resolução de impedimentos;   Identificar oportunidades de  melhoria contínua em processos, ferramentas e metodologias de gestão de projetos   ;   Atuar de forma próxima às equipes responsáveis pela implementação do SAP S/4HANA nos diferentes países, considerando particularidades locais e necessidades do programa global.     O que buscamos     Formação superior completa;   Experiência em  Gestão de Projetos, PMO ou gestão de processos   ;   Conhecimento avançado de  Excel   ;   Experiência com planejamento, acompanhamento de cronogramas, gestão de riscos, issues, dependências e indicadores;   Capacidade de estruturar e apresentar  status reports e apresentações executivas   para diferentes níveis de liderança;   Conhecimento em  metodologias e ferramentas de gestão de projetos   ;   Conhecimento em  DevOps   ;   Inglês fluente, com capacidade de atuar em ambiente global e interagir com stakeholders internacionais;   Disponibilidade para  viagens internacionais   aos países envolvidos na implementação dos projetos SAP;     Será considerado diferencial     Conhecimento em  SAP S/4HANA   ;   Conhecimento em  SAP   e/ou projetos de implementação de ERP;   Conhecimento em  Signavio   ;   Experiência em projetos de atuação  global ou multinacional   .     Benefícios    40 dias de home office;   Vale-refeição ou alimentação via iFood;   Vale-transporte;   Bônus;   Plano de saúde e telemedicina;   Convênio odontológico;   Convênio farmácia;   Seguro de vida;   Instituto Ambev de Previdência Privada;   Auxílio material escolar;   Cesta de Natal e kit congelado;   Brinquedos de Natal;   Empresa Cidadã, com licença-maternidade e paternidade, além de presente para o bebê;   Desconto mensal em produtos Ambev;   Wellhub (Gympass);   Transporte fretado;   Abono anual referente a um salário.

title: CONSULTOR COMERCIAL - CAMPINAS
description:
Confira a oportunidade para CONSULTOR COMERCIAL - CAMPINAS em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Iguatemi S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.   ⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO    Responsável pela comercialização dos espaços das lojas (SUCs: salão de uso comercial) nos shoppings de sua responsabilidade, maximizando a geração de receitas, superando as metas de redução de vacância estipuladas, substituindo operações não sadias e que não sejam aderentes ao mix do empreendimento, com objetivo de atingir ou superar a meta estipulada para cada SUC. Responsável em prospectar novos clientes com perfil desejado para atuar nos empreendimentos a serem comercializados, seguindo o direcionamento da área de Mix.    RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como?   Comercialização das áreas vagas: prospecção de novos lojistas, análise SWOT dos espaços ofertados(pontos fortes x desafios), negociações de valores e condições contratuais com lojistas, acompanhamento após a assinatura do contrato;   Estabelecer contato inicial com lojista: prospecção do contato comercial referente à marca indicada pelo Mix, apresentação da oportunidade para o lojista e captura de interesse preliminar do mesmo, agendamento e realização de reuniões;   Negociação: Elaboração da proposta comercial (Salesforce) com base nas metas definidas pelo Iguatemi, apresentação da proposta para o lojista e negociação da mesma, ajustes na proposta comercial se necessário, atualização do status de cada negociação no sistema, envio de informações técnicas sobre o SUC e levantamento junto ao lojista de eventuais necessidades de alterações para serem aprovadas e discutidas com demais áreas;   Acompanhar o andamento da proposta comercial no fluxo de aprovações e, após alçadas de aprovações internas, efetuar o retorno para o lojista;   Fechamento: Coleta de documentação e assinatura de contrato do lojista, entrega dos documentos para equipe de operações comerciais responsável pelos inputs de dados cadastrais;   Acompanhamento: Uma vez assinado o contrato, apresentar o lojista à equipe de operações e manutenção, efetuar o acompanhamento da obra periodicamente de modo a garantir abertura da loja. Uma vez que a loja esteja aberta, realizar as boas vindas ao lojista e passagem de bastão para área de operações;   Alimentar a base de contatos de lojistas do Iguatemi (Salesforce), fazendo inputs de dados cadastrais do mesmo (completando o que é previamente enviado por mix);   Participar das reuniões: RECOP, Matinais com GG, Reuniões semanais e mensais de atualização de status com Gerente Regional, Encontro Anual das Áreas e Programas de Excelência, entre outros.     OBSERVACÕES    Ensino Superior completo (mandatório);   CRECI - Conselho Regional de Corretores de Imóveis (mandatório);   Experiência prévia na área comercial como executivo/consultor comercial, preferencialmente em empresas de bens de consumo, shopping center, varejo ou imobiliária;   Conhecer bem os empreendimentos e oportunidades a serem vendidas (Concorrência, entorno, SWOT, etc).

title: Sales Account Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Sales Account Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Do you have a proven track record in technical sales and account management? Have you planned and successfully executed sales and account management strategies within the energy and/or engineering industry? Are you self-driven and goal oriented, with a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?  At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Sales Account Manager to both maintain and generate new business opportunities, while developing long-lasting relationships with clients across Brazil and South America.    DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We want to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.     About the Job    As our new Sales Account Manager, you will be responsible for servicing our accounts as well as growing our existing portfolio. You will work directly with electrical engineering firms, electrical contractors, general contractors, integrators, dealers and end users/owners, and will utilize previous technical knowledge and experience to grow sales and improve specification rates, while driving general acceptance of DEIF’s solutions.    Additionally, you will collaborate closely with the local DEIF integrators and future distributors to develop a complementary business growth process.    Working tasks & responsibilities    Servicing and developing/growing new key accounts targeted by the company by introducing products, conducting demos/trials for approvals, and securing contracts/orders.   Aligning individual (quarterly and annual) goals and contributions with the department goals, as well as the overall sales/growth strategy.   Working with OEMs, integrators, panel builders, end users, and other relevant stakeholders—especially in the rental and critical power sectors—to ensure pull-through and that DEIF solutions are specified.   Building strong, long-lasting relationships with electrical consultants and including DEIF’s products in their projects’ tenders.   Responsible for price negotiations for product sales.   Actively selling to new and existing customers all ranges of DEIF products including making “cold calls”.   Participating in exhibitions and trade shows.   Following price management processes and entering relevant leads/visits in CRM.   Focusing on process improvements and team collaboration with the Operations, Service & Support teams.   Escalating relevant issues that would need immediate attention to the department manager.   Understanding safety measures in line with our Global Safety Policy. Identifying gaps and proactively suggest improvements.   Visit customers     What you’ll bring    Bachelor’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering.  3 years’ progressive experience in technical sales/sales support with specific experience in distributed power generation, engine and generator technology, microgrids , alternative fuels, automatic transfer switches, automation or related field.   Experience with end-to-end sales cycle, from lead generation to deal closure.   A hunter mentality, with high resilience and proactive approach.   Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build solid, long-lasting relationships.   Knowledge of industry/market and customers.   Ability to travel as needed.   English language is mandatory; Spanish language skills will be considered a differential.   Knowledge of applications and products.   Excellent communication skills – Verbal, written and presentation skills.   Experience working with CRM systems.   Team player with growth mindset.   Knowledge of the marine segment and PLCs will be considered a differential.     At DEIF, we are Winning Together!   We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential. The Lead will combine a process-driven mindset with solid scientific knowledge to draft regulatory submissions, manage Planned Environmental Releases (LPMAs), and author technical responses to CTNBio's official inquiries. Additionally, this position will drive regulatory intelligence and oversee VCU (Value for Cultivation and Use) trials required for variety registration with MAPA. Leverage a solid background in molecular biology to support regulatory strategies and technical rationales for gene-edited products, addressing official consultations for NBTs. Interface with global R&D teams to translate, adapt, and validate global data into the standard format required by Brazilian authorities. Proven experience in technical writing for biotechnology regulatory affairs in Brazil. Demonstrated track record in drafting CTNBio dossiers and handling official inquiries.   Deep, process-oriented understanding of CTNBio requirements, with solid experience evaluating complex molecular characterization data. This includes hands-on familiarity with southern blot analysis, next-generation sequencing (NGS), flanking sequences, allergenicity/toxicity profiles, and food/feed/environmental risk assessment data packages.   Familiarity with MAPA’s administrative and legal frameworks, specifically regarding VCU (Valor de Cultivo e Uso) trial protocols, data alignment, and RNC (Registro Nacional de Cultivares) registration procedures to ensure the smooth transition from biosafety approval to commercial seed licensing.   Attention to quality and detail-oriented.   Efficient and timeline driven.   Excellent oral and written communication (including presentation) skills. Manage quality follow-up during prototype builds, trial builds, pilot production, and production ramp-up. Participate in product and process change management to ensure alignment among the Bill of Materials, drawings, process documents, software versions, inspection standards, and actual production configuration, preventing incorrect assembly, missing parts, and mixed product versions.  10. Establish control and traceability mechanisms for special characteristics, critical dimensions, critical torque values, and regulatory components, ensuring that all relevant quality data is accurate, complete, and readily traceable.  11. Manage the calibration and control of gauges, measuring instruments, inspection equipment, and testing equipment. Promptly organize risk assessments for issues involving vehicle safety, regulatory compliance, or potential batch exposure. This role is crucial to ensuring that internal teams (sales, ops, marketing, etc.) can operate without IT friction or downtime. The ideal person is a hands‑on problem‑solver with strong ownership, technical versatility, and clear communication. Responsibilities Manage user lifecycle, including provisioning, de‑provisioning, access controls, and permissions across systems (G Suite, Office 365, Slack, internal tools). Oversee hardware and software asset inventory, including acquisitions, deployments, refresh cycles, and warranties. Set up, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot workstations, peripherals, mobile devices, VPNs, and basic network connectivity. Troubleshoot and resolve user IT tickets (desktop, laptop, OS, connectivity, software) promptly. Coordinate with vendors for support, maintenance, and procurement (SaaS tools, licensing). Create, maintain and enforce internal IT policies and standards (passwords, device encryption, backup, patching). Support onboarding and off‑boarding processes with IT compliance (access removal, exit checklist). Monitor and manage internal systems (file shares, backup, printers, internal tools) and alert on issues. Create and maintain documentation of IT processes, configurations, user guides, and policies. Assist with small infrastructure projects (office moves, network upgrades, software rollouts). Escalate and coordinate with Engineering and Security teams when needed (e.g., deeper system issues).  Requisitos Technical diploma in Information Systems, Systems Analysis or related degree. Experience (3+ years) in an IT support, systems, or operations role (generalist). Strong experience with user and access management systems (e.g., Google Workspace, SSO, IAM). Experience with service management frameworks / ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, ServiceNow). Hands‑on experience with Windows / macOS workstations and standard corporate software stacks. Basic knowledge of network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP) and troubleshooting. Familiarity with device management (MDM), patching, endpoint security. Experience with inventory / asset management systems. Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to work autonomously. Good organizational skills and attention to detail. Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, Slack. Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team. title: Analista Monitoramento e Observabilidade Sr (Infraestrutura de TI)
description:

Analista Monitoramento e Observabilidade Sr (Infraestrutura de TI) Psicóloga | Analista de RH | Recrutamento e Seleção Seu futuro merece essa energia!  Nós acreditamos que a energia que você dedica à sua carreira merece retorno. Por isso, reconhecemos a dedicação das nossas pessoas e estamos sempre em busca de quem deseja fazer a diferença e construir uma trajetória próspera e segura. Na CPFL, você encontra um ambiente sólido para crescer com confiança, com segurança para evoluir e espaço para construir um futuro com propósito. Analista Monitoramento e Observabilidade Sr (Infraestrutura de TI)  Modelo de trabalho:  Presencial Empresa:  CPFL RGE – Uma empresa do Grupo CPFL Energia. Necessário ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas; Desejável certificações em ITIL, monitoramento de infraestrutura, observabilidade ou segurança; Necessário experiência em monitoramento e observabilidade; Atuação prévia em NOC, SOC, command center ou service desk 24x7; Gestão de eventos críticos e boas práticas de monitoração proativa; Processos de escalonamento de incidentes e acionamento de equipes técnicas; Disponibilidade para atuar em Campinas, SP. Experiência sólida com plataformas como Datadog, Splunk, Zabbix, Grafana, Dynatrace, New Relic ou similares. Processos de escalonamento de incidentes e acionamento de equipes técnicas. Gestão de eventos críticos e boas práticas de monitoração proativa.  Habilidades comportamentais:  Liderança e postura estratégica em momentos de crise, com comunicação clara e assertiva. Raciocínio analítico e atenção a detalhes. Comunicação objetiva e clara. Capacidade analítica e foco em detalhes, especialmente sob pressão.  O seu dia a dia:  Supervisionar ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade, garantindo eficiência e qualidade no acompanhamento de ambientes críticos. Atuar no acionamento e coordenação de times técnicos em incidentes, priorizando a rápida mitigação de impactos. Conduzir war rooms e follow-ups estruturados em crises, produzindo relatórios e indicadores executivos. Promover a melhoria contínua de dashboards, alertas e processos de monitoramento, em parceria com áreas técnicas. Atualizar e manter documentação, playbooks e análises post-mortem, assegurando governança e lições aprendidas.  O que oferecemos:  Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Assistência Médica; Assistência Odontológica; Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade); Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).  Conheça um pouco sobre nós:  Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços. Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro. Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento. Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas. title: Mecânico especialista (técnico automotivo)
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Mecânico especialista (técnico automotivo) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Mecânico especialista (técnico automotivo) A Mecânico Delivery é uma empresa que presta serviço de agenciamento de serviços mecânicos automotivos corretivos e preventivos a domicílio, ou seja, o mecânico vai até o local onde o veículo se encontra para realizar o trabalho. Não trabalhamos com estrutura de oficina, por isso oferecemos serviços expressos que podem ser realizados na casa ou trabalho do cliente. Executar manutenções corretivas e preventivas expressas no local do cliente. Realizar diagnósticos dos problemas apresentados pelos clientes. Fornecer estimativas de mão de obra e tempo para reparos automotivos adicionais.  Requisitos  Experiência e conhecimento em linha leve multimarcas para os serviços relacionados. Autonomia para executar os serviços contratados de forma independente. Não se importar com clientes que queiram acompanhar o serviço. Possuir maquininha de cartão de crédito/débito.  Como funciona para o mecânico  O mecânico selecionado passa a fazer parte da nossa base cadastral, recebendo propostas de serviços conforme solicitados pelos clientes. A Mecânico Delivery trabalha todos os dias da semana, inclusive feriados, mas o mecânico define os dias e horários que deseja receber propostas de serviços. Não exigimos dedicação exclusiva. A jornada de trabalho é flexível, e o mecânico aceita apenas as propostas nos dias e horários desejados. Pagamos um valor fixo por hora trabalhada, muito acima do valor pago atualmente pelas oficinas tradicionais, porém esse valor não inclui despesas de deslocamento (veículo e combustível) nem ferramentas. Nosso sistema é de intermediação, ficando a Mecânico Delivery com uma parte do valor cobrado do cliente.  #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Fundada em 2007, a SERCAMP ENGENHARIA ELÉTRICA, ao longo dos anos, tornou‑se uma empresa próspera e bem estruturada, capaz de criar soluções de maneira simples. Além de pioneira, é também inovadora em manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em transformadores, disjuntores, chaves seccionadoras, cabines de distribuição e subestações, entre outros.  A empresa conta ainda com equipamentos modernos para ensaios elétricos em transformadores, bem como com uma frota própria para a execução dos serviços em qualquer ponto do país.  A SERCAMP® está sempre buscando a sustentabilidade e práticas de melhoramento contínuo em sua prestação de serviço. Junto a sua equipe realiza treinamentos de conscientização, criando um ambiente de trabalho focado em responsabilidade socioambiental. Acreditando, assim, que suas ações podem servir de exemplo para outras organizações e pessoas para uso consciente dos recursos naturais.  Nossa empresa é reconhecida pela qualidade e confiabilidade. Somos especialistas em manutenção preditiva, preventiva e corretiva de equipamentos de baixa, média e alta tensão. Atuamos em transformadores, disjuntores, cabines de distribuição e muito mais.  Sobre seu Papel  Eletricista de manutenção industrial é garantir que os sistemas e equipamentos elétricos da companhia funcionem de forma segura, eficiente e contínua, por meio da manutenção preventiva e corretiva.  Realiza instalações, inspeciona e testa circuitos, diagnostica e repara falhas, implementa Medidas de segurança, e colabora com outros departamentos para otimizar a produção e evitar paradas não planejadas, assegurando a produtividade e a vida útil dos ativos da empresa.  Responsabilidades   Manutenção de Transformadores: Realizar manutenções preventivas e corretivas em transformadores, cubículos e outros componentes elétricos.    Qualificações  Habilidades Necessárias   Conhecimento em Eletricidade: Experiência em instalações, medições, manutenção de sistemas e equipamentos elétricos.  Conhecimento e cumprimento das normas regulamentadoras, como NR-10 e NR-35.  Habilidade no uso de ferramentas e equipamentos elétricos e uso correto de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs).  Interpretar diagramas e projetos elétricos para a execução das atividades.    Habilidades Preferenciais   Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais.    Benefícios   Remuneração a Combinar.  Refeição no local, VT (pago em dinheiro), seguro de vida, incentivo à faculdade, premiação, massagem terapêutica, convênio farmácia, Total Pass, Telemedicina. description:

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.  About ABI Growth Group  ABI’s Growth Division is the center of innovation and tech development within ABI, which is driving ABI’s growth by developing innovations for the core beer business and creating new hyper‑growth tech businesses. ABI Growth includes the following business lines: BEES (our business‑to‑business e‑commerce and SaaS business, also focused on new technologies), TaDa and Ze Delivery (our direct‑to‑consumer e‑commerce businesses), and several other high‑tech divisions, including fintech and venture capital.  This role will be largely dedicated to BEES, which is on a mission to transform ABI’s business‑to‑business sales model by putting customers and data at its heart. Whether you are a small to medium sized retailer or a supplying partner, BEES provides you with the tools, data, and insights you need to help your business thrive. Today, more than 2.5 million retailers across 19 countries use BEES every month to browse for products, place orders, earn rewards, arrange deliveries, manage invoices, and access business insights all from one place.  Learn more on how BEES keeps business buzzing at   About the Role  The Commercial Strategy Specialist is responsible for maximizing profitable growth across BEES Link 3P through strong governance, analytical rigor, and scalable operating standards. Aligned with our mission — to maximize profitable growth by institutionalizing pricing compliance, P&L governance, disciplined product prioritization, and scalable operating processes — this role plays a critical part in strengthening the structural foundations of our commercial model.  This position sits at the intersection of Commercial, Product, Finance, and Operations. The Commercial Strategy Specialist transforms complex business problems into data‑driven insights and scalable frameworks that protect margins, improve investment allocation, and accelerate disciplined decision‑making. This is a high‑impact role designed for a senior professional who combines strategic thinking with hands‑on analytical execution.  What you'll do   Own P&L governance for BEES Link 3P, consolidating partner‑level performance data and translating it into clear visibility on margin health, revenue quality, and profitability trends.  Provide broad‑ranging legal advice to other teams across ABI Growth, including relating to SaaS and licensing transactions, strategic commercial relationships, data monetization strategies, data privacy projects, and product counseling.  Build and maintain scalable operating frameworks — standard templates, decision criteria, governance protocols — that reduce dependency on ad hoc judgement and improve process consistency.  Drive product prioritization rigor by developing structured intake processes, effort‑impact scoring models, and backlog governance routines that align roadmap decisions with commercial outcomes.  Design and maintain investment evaluation frameworks that assess initiatives against a shared value logic, distinguishing between cost avoidance, governance improvement, and incremental revenue generation.  Develop and update reference models for take rate and GMV impact analysis, enabling leadership to make pricing and product decisions grounded in real partner data.  Identify operational bottlenecks and inefficiencies across the OTC and GTM cycle, and lead initiatives to eliminate waste and improve execution speed without compromising governance standards.  Synthesize cross‑functional inputs — from Commercial, Finance, Product, and Operations — into integrated business reviews that surface risks early and enable proactive course correction.  Support JBP structuring and partner onboarding processes by providing analytical and governance scaffolding that ensures new engagements are commercially sound from the outset.    What you'll need   Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; advanced degree (MBA, MSc) is a strong differentiator.  Experience in a business analytics, commercial operations, strategy, or financial governance role, ideally within a technology, marketplace, or CPG environment.  Proven ability to build and operationalize governance frameworks, pricing models, or P&L management tools in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.  Strong analytical proficiency — advanced Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, or Python/R — with the ability to work directly with large datasets and translate findings into executive‑level insights.  Demonstrated experience with take rate modelling, GMV analysis, or margin management in a platform or marketplace business is a significant plus.  Desire to help build the legal function and data privacy program from the ground up.  Effective communicator who can synthesize complex analytical work into clear business narratives for senior leadership and cross‑functional partners.  Practical legal approach, focused on enabling the business strategy rather than a compliance‑first mindset.  Fully fluent in English and Portuguese; proficiency in Spanish is a plus. title: Staff Product Engineer (Campinas)
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Staff Product Engineer (Campinas) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Overview  This is a remote role for candidates located in Campinas, Brazil.  LawnStarter is the nation’s leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $100M in annual bookings. We’re expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all home services — operating across three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, Home Gnome) on a single shared platform.  About Engineering at LawnStarter  We’re restructuring engineering around initiative teams: a Product Engineer paired with a PM and a designer, with an Engineering Manager who covers a couple of initiatives and supports your growth. The engineer leads AI agents like a team, ships the work, and is accountable — with the rest of the triangle — for whether the initiative moves its metric.  We’re betting that 1–2 strong engineers running AI agents can outship the labor-team model that defined the last decade of software. That bet only works if the engineers we hire are wired for ownership and can ship to a marketplace with real customers and pros on both sides.  The Role  You’re the engineering anchor of one initiative at a time. The initiative is a team effort — an iron triangle of you, your PM, and your designer — and you have key participation across the full lifecycle: shaping the problem, deciding the technical approach, leading the AI agents that implement most of the code, shipping to production, and answering for the outcome alongside the rest of the triangle.  You’re accountable for the outcome — not for the volume of code merged. If an agent can ship it safely, your job is to make sure the agent does it right and the metric moves. If the initiative needs hand-written code in a sensitive area, you write it yourself.  What makes this role different:   You lead AI agents, not humans. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and our internal agent stack are your team. You own the quality, safety, and velocity of what they produce.  You own an outcome, not a ticket queue. Problem-framing through production through the metric review 2–4 weeks after launch.  You partner horizontally with PM and design. No tech lead above you. No architect approval. No ticket grooming committee.  The bar is staff, not senior. You make the call when the call needs to be made. If you’re waiting to be told, this isn’t the role.    What You’ll Own   The technical approach  — architecture, data model, integration choices, rollout plan, observability, and rollback strategy for your initiative. You make the call, document it, and revisit it if the data says you were wrong.  Agent-led implementation quality  — the prompts, guardrails, evals, tests, and review loop that let agents ship safe, correct, production-ready code on your initiative. Most lines will be agent-authored. You’re accountable for them.  Cross-functional partnership  — daily working contact with your PM (scope, tradeoffs) and your designer (UX decisions, in-tool prototyping with agents), and weekly check-ins with your EM (initiative health, blockers, growth).  The initiative outcome  — the specific metric the initiative was set up to move. In partnership with your PM, you present results 2–4 weeks post-launch and share the “did it work” answer.  A high bar for what ships under your name  — production correctness, security posture, performance, observability, and the experience for customers and pros. Agents accelerate you; they don’t lower the bar.    Problems to Solve  Leading AI agents at staff-level quality  — Most of the code on your initiative will be authored by AI agents. The work is making agents ship as if a senior engineer wrote it: prompts that encode our codebase conventions, evals that catch hallucinations before merge, tests that exercise the edges, observability that catches the regression in production before a customer reports it. How do you build the agent workflow that lets one engineer ship what used to take a team?  Owning an outcome without a tech lead  — You don’t have a tech lead to approve your design or an architect to escalate to. You have an EM who covers a couple of initiatives and peers on adjacent ones. How do you make calls fast, document them clearly, and stay accountable to the outcome — without slowing down for hierarchy that no longer exists?  Shipping outcomes, not features  — The initiative will be measured by a metric — a conversion rate, a retention curve, a pro-funnel KPI, a unit economics shift. You’re accountable for the number, not the feature. How do you scope to actually move it, decide what to build, and have the discipline to follow up 2–4 weeks after launch even when the next initiative is calling?  What Success Looks Like (Year 1)   Initiative outcomes hit  — You’ve shipped 3–4 initiatives end-to-end, and at least two clearly moved the metric they were set up to move (with the post-launch review to prove it).  Agent workflow that travels  — The prompts, evals, and review loop you built for your initiative are adopted by at least one other engineer on an adjacent initiative.  Cycle time  — Median time from problem-framing to first production rollout on your initiatives is meaningfully shorter than the pre-restructure baseline.  Zero agent-shipped that incidents  — No customer- or pro-facing regression traceable to agent-authored code that you missed in review.  Visible leverage  — Other engineers point to artifacts you left behind — runbooks, evals, agent workflows, post-launch write-ups — as references they use.    Who You Are  AI-native.  Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or equivalent are how you ship — daily, on production work. You have opinions about prompts, evals, agent loops, MCP servers, and review workflows, and you know when to let the agent run vs. write it yourself. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you describe AI coding as “something you’re exploring” or prefer to write everything by hand.  Already operating at lead level.  You may currently be titled Senior, Staff, Lead, or Principal — but in practice you’ve been the person making the call, shipping the hard thing, and answering for whether it worked. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you’ve always had a tech lead breaking down the work for you.  Outcome-driven, not output-driven.  You measure your week in “did the metric move” and “did the experience get better,” not in tickets closed. You read the post-launch dashboard and you own the answer. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you take pride in volume of code shipped or feel uncomfortable being measured on a number you don’t fully control.  A strong horizontal partner.  You hold your own with a strong PM and a strong designer. You bring engineering judgment to product calls and product judgment to engineering calls. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you hide behind “that’s product’s decision” or default to RICE-scoring tickets handed down to you.  Decisive and documented.  Architecture decisions, data-model choices, rollout plans — you write them down, get fast input, and move. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you wait for consensus on questions that have a clear right answer, or if you make calls and never write them down.  Raises the floor, not just the ceiling.  Your impact compounds beyond your own initiative because you leave artifacts — agent workflows, evals, runbooks, post-launch reviews. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you’re a lone wolf who ships brilliantly but leaves nothing reusable behind.  Cares about customers and pros.  This is a real-world marketplace with real people on both sides. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you’re chasing pure engineering elegance over business and customer outcomes.  This Role Is NOT    A tech lead in an old-style team.  No 4–5 engineers reporting up to you on technical direction. The team is you + PM + designer + EM, with AI agents doing most of the implementation.  A management role today.  People management is the EM’s job in this role. That said, the path can grow into management for those who want it — it’s an open door, not a closed one.  A platform-only or architecture-only role.  You’re a Product Engineer. You ship features that move metrics, end-to-end. Platform work happens inside the initiative when it’s needed for the outcome.  A “let AI do everything” role. description:

Na CI&T , ajudamos grandes empresas a transformar o potencial da AI em impacto real nos negócios com AI Deployment, execução AI-native e tech-integrated business solutions.  Com 30 anos de experiência em transformação tecnológica, aceleramos inovação com expertise em agentic SDLC, application modernization, Data & AI, martech e business strategy.
